test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 22 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Under which ministry was the National Mission for Manuscripts established in February 2003?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Tourism and Culture.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The National Mission for Manuscripts (NAMAMI) **is an autonomous organisation under the **Ministry of Culture, Government of India, **tasked with surveying, locating, and conserving Indian manuscripts in order to build a national resource base for manuscripts and improve access, awareness, and educational use.
 
• The Mission was launched in** February 2003 by the Ministry of Tourism and Culture of the Government of India,** with the **Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (IGNCA) **serving as the project's coordinating agency.
 
• It compiles bibliographic databases of Indian manuscripts and assists in manuscript conservation and preservation.
 
• The organisation strives to encourage access and scholarship through study and publication on the subject of Indian manuscript restoration and conservation, as well as its digitalization.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The Ministry of Culture** is an Indian government ministry responsible for preserving and promoting Indian art and culture. The current Minister of Culture is G. Kishan Reddy.
 
• **The Ministry of Tourism **is the top organisation for the formulation and administration of rules, regulations, and legislation relating to the development and promotion of tourism in India. It is a branch of the Indian government.
 
• **The Ministry of Education (previously the Ministry of Human Resource Development)** is the Indian government's ministry in charge of implementing the National Policy on Education. 
 
• **The Ministry of Finance** is the Indian Treasury and is responsible for the country's economy.
